name: Lateral Condyle Fracture of Humerus in Children
tags: lateral condyle fracture of humerus in children
definition: Pediatric intra-articular fracture of the lateral humeral condyle with risk of displacement, nonunion and growth disturbance.

investigations.principle: AP/lateral and oblique elbow radiographs assess displacement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced fractures commonly require fixation; close radiographic follow-up is essential even when initially treated nonoperatively.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern fracture care.

patientEducation.summary: Pediatric intra-articular fracture of the lateral humeral condyle with risk of displacement, nonunion and growth disturbance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
